applies_to: cleanup BG (Agent run_in_background=true) operations on training runs, watchdogs, scratch scripts, savepoints
implementation_status: RECOMMENDATION_ONLY — guards are NOT enforced this cycle; future cycle must convert to harness hook + prompt template

guards.name: explicit_cleanup_verb_taxonomy
guards.rule: every cleanup BG instruction MUST classify the action into exactly one of three disjoint verbs

verb_taxonomy.SIGTERM_ONLY: send SIGTERM to PID; do NOT touch files
verb_taxonomy.DELETE_SCRIPT: remove a specific named .py / .hexa script after confirming process is dead
verb_taxonomy.FULL_SWEEP: SIGKILL + remove work dir + remove savepoints (destructive — requires explicit user OK)

guards.enforcement: parent prompt template — `cleanup_action: <SIGTERM_ONLY|DELETE_SCRIPT|FULL_SWEEP>` field is REQUIRED; cleanup BG aborts if field absent or ambiguous
guards.fallback_when_unclear: default to SIGTERM_ONLY; never escalate without explicit re-confirm

guards.name: pre_post_state_verification_via_separate_channel
guards.rule: cleanup BG MUST capture state BEFORE acting and AFTER acting via a channel independent of the target process
required_pre_state_capture: PID exit code (if process already gone)
required_post_state_capture: savepoint_dir mtime + file count (delta vs pre)
log tail again (delta vs pre — did it write more after action?)
guards.report_format: post-cleanup BG MUST emit JSON: {killed: [...], preserved: [...], lost: [...], pre_state, post_state}
guards.enforcement: parent rejects cleanup BG report if missing any of the 4 fields above

guards.name: process_death_is_not_success
guards.rule: PID-absent MUST NOT be reported as 'completed' without verifying at least one positive success signal
required_success_signals_any_one: verdict.json present with verdict in {PASS, ALL_GREEN, CLEAN_*}
log tail contains 'training complete' or equivalent terminal sentinel
required_failure_signals_any_one_implies: stderr file size > 0 with non-empty last 100 chars
expected savepoint absent AND wall-time < expected
guards.fallback_when_signals_conflict: report 'INDETERMINATE — manual inspection required'; never default to 'completed'
guards.enforcement: cleanup BG prompt template includes explicit signal checklist; parent rejects 'completed' verdict that lacks at least one positive signal

guards.name: long_running_script_immutable_location
guards.rule: any training script expected to run > 60s MUST be copied to a read-only location BEFORE launch; the launched process references the RO copy, not the scratch copy

recommended_locations.mac_local: N/A — Mac BANS .py per raw#9; hexa scripts under /opt/anima_runtime/hexa/<run_id>/

lifecycle: 1. parent BG copies script to RO location, chmod 0444
2. parent BG launches process pointing at RO copy
3. cleanup BG (any verb) is BANNED from touching RO location
4. RO cleanup is a separate later GC cycle, gated on age (e.g., > 7 days) and absence of any savepoint mtime touch
guards.enforcement: launch BG prompt template requires `script_ro_path` field; cleanup BG prompt template includes explicit deny-list for /opt/anima_runtime/* and /workspace/runtime/*

complexity_caveat: raw#10 honest — guards add ~30-50% overhead to cleanup BG prompt length and ~5-10s per cleanup wall time (extra log tail + state snapshot). Net win expected only if cleanup incidents > 1 per 100 BGs (current observed rate ≈ 2 per ~50 BGs this session = above threshold)
retroactive_caveat: raw#10 honest — guards apply to FUTURE cleanup BGs only; cannot retroactively recover lost step_2000 + final savepoints from INC-2026-05-03-A. Recovery requires re-train (cost: ~$3-5 RunPod or 1-2hr ubu1)
audit_completeness_caveat: raw#10 honest — only 2 incidents documented because they reached parent attention; silent cleanup mishaps (e.g., savepoint deleted without parent noticing) are NOT counted. True incident rate likely higher

convert GUARD-3 signal checklist to a hook (post-BG validator)
